# meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_event (Resource)

This resource can manage the `Network Firmware Upgrades Staged Event` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_event" "example" {
  network_id                                          = "L_123456"
  products_switch_next_upgrade_to_version_id          = "1234"
  products_switch_catalyst_next_upgrade_to_version_id = "4321"
  stages = [
    {
      group_id                 = "1234"
      milestones_scheduled_for = "2018-02-11T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID
- `stages` (Attributes List) All firmware upgrade stages in the network with their start time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stages))

### Optional

- `products_switch_catalyst_next_upgrade_to_version_id` (String) The version ID
- `products_switch_next_upgrade_to_version_id` (String) The version ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--stages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stages`

Optional:

- `group_id` (String) ID of the Staged Upgrade Group
- `milestones_scheduled_for` (String) The start time of the staged upgrade stage. (In ISO-8601 format, in the time zone of the network.)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_event.example
  identity = {
    network_id = "<network_id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_event.example
  id = "<network_id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_event.example "<network_id>"
```
